# telnyx_rcs_agent_launch (Action)

Submits an RCS agent for launch with its campaign and testing details, so carriers can approve it to message users.



<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `agent_id` (String) The agent id.
- `campaign` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--campaign))
- `testing` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--testing))

<a id="nestedatt--campaign"></a>
### Nested Schema for `campaign`

Required:

- `agent_overview` (String)
- `company_overview` (String)
- `consent_settings` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--campaign--consent_settings))
- `interactions` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--campaign--interactions))
- `message_examples` (List of String)

Optional:

- `additional_information` (String)

<a id="nestedatt--campaign--consent_settings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `campaign.consent_settings`

Required:

- `call_to_action` (String)
- `double_opt_in` (Boolean)
- `help_response` (String)
- `opt_in_message` (String)
- `opt_in_methods` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--campaign--consent_settings--opt_in_methods))
- `opt_out_response` (String)

Optional:

- `call_to_action_media_url` (String) Required when an opt-in method is `WEBSITE` or `MOBILE_APP`.
- `call_to_action_url` (String) Required when an opt-in method is `WEBSITE`.
- `double_opt_in_message` (String) Required when double_opt_in is true.

<a id="nestedatt--campaign--consent_settings--opt_in_methods"></a>
### Nested Schema for `campaign.consent_settings.opt_in_methods`

Required:

- `method_type` (String) One of `MOBILE_APP`, `OTHER`, `QR_CODE`, `SALE_POINT`, `SMS`, `WEBSITE`.

Optional:

- `description` (String) Required when method_type is `OTHER`.



<a id="nestedatt--campaign--interactions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `campaign.interactions`

Required:

- `interaction_type` (String) One of `ACCOUNT_ALERTS`, `CUSTOMER_SUPPORT`, `LOYALTY_OR_REWARD`, `MARKETING_OR_PROMOTIONAL`, `OTHER`, `TRANSACTIONAL_UPDATES`, `TWO_WAY_CONVERSATION`.

Optional:

- `description` (String) Required when interaction_type is `OTHER`.



<a id="nestedatt--testing"></a>
### Nested Schema for `testing`

Required:

- `test_url` (String)

Optional:

- `additional_information` (String)
- `message_id` (String)
